subject.title: [Bug]: Session stuck in permanent busy state after mid-turn gateway restart — no auto-recovery, only /new or /reset clears it

question: What proof should be required before this issue can close after the related recovery and delivery fixes land?
rationale: Current source shows partial recovery and multiple open fix paths, but the public field report failed after recovery had already begun, so source-level proof alone may not settle the real Telegram/macOS restart workflow.

options.title: Require Live Restart Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a real or Crabbox-equivalent macOS/Telegram mid-turn restart proves recovery through final delivery and a follow-up message without manual reset.

options.title: Accept Source Plus Targeted Runtime Proof
options.body: Allow closure after the related PRs land with focused tests and local runtime hook/lane proof, without requiring external Telegram credentials.

options.title: Split And Close Narrowly
options.body: Close this only after the busy-state lane is proven fixed, and move final-delivery or broader restart policy gaps to canonical linked issues.

recommendation.title: Require Live Restart Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a real or Crabbox-equivalent macOS/Telegram mid-turn restart proves recovery through final delivery and a follow-up message without manual reset.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current startup recovery implementation that future closure proof needs to validate end to end.
